item.title: SPLASHING WORKS: Watford paddling pools undergo maintenance ahead of summer
item.description: Essential maintenance is currently underway at Cassiobury Park’s paddling pools, ensuring efficient operation for the upcoming seasons. Watford Borough Council (WBC) announced work, which includes replacing antiquated water recirculation tanks. Since their 2017 opening, these pools have become a summer favourite for families.
